name: Égua Branca
body:
Égua Branca
CR 11

XP 12,800
N Large magical beast (unique)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 29, touch 14, flat-footed 24 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +15 natural, -1 size)
hp 168 (16d10+80)
Fort +15, Ref +14, Will +10; SR 22

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee bite +23 (1d4+8), 2 hooves +22 (1d8+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks trample (1d6+12, DC 26)

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 18, Con 21, Int 2, Wis 17, Cha 11
Base Atk +16; CMB +25; CMD 39
Feats Dodge, Endurance, Improved Natural Attack (hooves), Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Run, Weapon Focus (hooves)
Skills Fly +12, Perception +20
Languages Common, Sylvan (cannot speak)

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization pair (with rider)
Treasure none

Velha da Égua Branca, “the Old Woman on the White Mare,” is a mysterious and terrifying figure. It is said that at night, she rides her white mare, startling animals and folk alike.

Despite this, she does not usually harm others. Woe to those that offend her sense of justice, however. Some say she belongs to the night sky, while others say she is the remnant of a long-forgotten titan or deity. She rarely speaks, but what she has to say is likely of great import, perhaps a warning or exhortation. If found in her lair, she may be persuaded to speak, but finding her home is a quest for the truly determined and daring. Her mare is her formidable companion.
